**EL-RSP-1.2 Turn decision to bus within 60 ms**

BCM_Lighting shall send the TurnLightControl frame carrying the new turn state within 60 ms of receiving the TurnStalk or HazardLightButton frame that caused it: at most 10 ms of processing plus at most one 50 ms TurnLightControl cycle.

The first on-phase shall be output when the new state is entered, not at the first blink tick.

description: Allocated to building block LightingControl. Second segment of the EL-RSP-1 budget. Starting the on-phase on state entry matters: waiting for the first 1 s blink tick would alone exceed 200 ms.
